title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo
tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

judge.summary: The edit delivers a polished square LinkedIn headshot, preserving her likeness and curly hair while adding a navy blazer and plain light grey background.

must_haves.item: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
must_haves.why: Her facial features, expression, and distinctive dark curls remain recognisably consistent with the original.
A clearly navy blazer with natural-looking lapels and seams is visible.

must_haves.item: The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
must_haves.why: The park has been fully replaced by an uncluttered light grey backdrop.

must_haves.item: The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
must_haves.why: The image is square, her head and shoulders are centred, and there is clear space above her hair.

must_haves.item: Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.
must_haves.why: Soft lighting, visible skin texture, and coherent clothing details look natural, with no obvious artifacts.
